service.name: Time
service.description: Owns calendar and event data (CalDAV-backed calendar objects: events and tasks), scoped strictly to the authenticated member's own calendar.

capabilities.description: Search the member's own calendar objects (events and tasks) by title, description, or location.
List the member's recent calendar objects.
Open a single calendar object already identified by a prior Dataset action.
Discover the calendars available to the member.
Update or delete an existing calendar (not the Social mirror calendar, which cannot be deleted from Time).
Show calendar events within a requested time range, including recurring events.
Show the member's tasks, filtered by status or due date, including overdue tasks.
Create, update, and delete calendar events.
Create, update, complete, reopen, and delete tasks.
